name: RankAsk
description:
Put options in order (rollout groups, fallback printers). Each row moves with its arrow
buttons or Alt+↑ / Alt+↓; the grip shows it can be reordered.

props.name: ask
props.type: { type: "rank"; options: ChoiceOption[]; } & { id: string; question: string; detail?: string; status?: import("../types.js").AskState; answer?: string; answeredBy?: string; answeredByEntity?: import("../types.js").EntityRef; answeredAt?: number; submitLabel?: string; }
props.description: The ranking ask: the question and its `options` in their starting order; the answer is the reordered list. Answers go to the `answer` conversation handler; once answered, expired or cancelled the card shows its record.
